doc: Citlalpol in Tezcatl (D-citlalpol-bus): how often citlalpol_bus reads the records through the relay (GET /citlalpol/records), how many it keeps for a panel opened later, and the glyphs citlalpol_image draws a packet with. A glyph is chosen from the record's structured fields only (decision, proto, port, method, path's extension, default) -- the first rule that matches; every field of a rule must match. Edit freely.

glyphs.why: declared, nothing decided to return (swallow's 501; older records)
a name asked in the wall (Citlalpol answers the wall's DNS)
TCP that ignored the proxy (forbidden's catch-all)
